reviews.title: Editors’ Choice
reviews.review: Drift off or dial in with BetterSleep—an app that puts you in control of your soundscapes. Mix everything from crackling campfires to morning birds, or explore the app’s library of meditations, sleep tales, breath work exercises, and more.

reviews.title: Three things :)
reviews.review: This app does exactly as it says it does! It has many features that help motivate me and help me feel rested. I’d suggest listening to one of the meditation sessions or a comfort story while taking a bath after a workout. Such a relaxing feeling. Overall a great app. The only disadvantage is you miss out on a lot of the many stories and meditation sessions if you don’t buy the subscription. reviews.title: Hands down best sleep/soundscape app
reviews.review: I’ve tried a lot of things for sleep sounds. But, year after year after year (how long have I been using this? A decade at least!), I consistently use this app. It’s always improving, even though I’ve never personally found it lacking. It’s amazing to have so much ability to customise mixes. I like layering multiple water sounds, brown noise, and a little quiet thunder. It’s created an almost Pavlovian response; I start playing my mix, and next thing I know, I’m asleep. reviews.review: After my mother's bloody death, sleep became a distant memory. I was up all the time. Couldn't sleep.
